name: four_sequential_gates
why: The agreed layout fixture of UNIFIED_TURN_BLOCK.md Phase 0. One turn pauses four times. Every layer -- app-graph harness, acceptance matrix, convergence oracle, browser evidence -- describes THIS scenario, so 'four requests, one group' means the same thing in all of them.
final_answer: Scaffold ready. I wrote README.md and src/index.js and removed src/old.js. I did not run npm init because you denied it.
notes: Steps 1 and 3 are the SAME tool with different arguments: distinct gate ids must produce distinct rows (acceptance matrix 'Repeated identical tool/arguments').
Step 2 is denied and the turn continues: denial is not turn failure (plan section 7).
Decision and execution are separate columns: 'Approved' never implies 'Execution completed' (plan section 3).
The four rows must remain four rows after refresh, session switch and restart (invariants U07, U12).
